answer: Reaching the fable of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The crystal holds work receipts rather than names, so the vault of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
